_about: Go-live criteria agreed with the client before the pilot. Each check reads one figure from the evaluation summary. 'blocking' checks must pass for a GO; the others are reported and can be accepted with a sign-off note.

checks.label: No invented answers to questions the documents cannot answer
Answer accuracy (verified and contains the expected figure)
Citation accuracy (cites a page with the evidence)
Unanswerable questions correctly said not found
Retrieval: evidence page among retrieved passages
